messages:
Nora: Ran through the model catalog compare flow in compact density mode and found a few accessibility + clarity issues. Nora: 1) When the filter rail collapses, theres no announcement — screen reader users lose context. Nora: 2) Performance badges use color + tiny icon but we don't provide a legend or inline text for compact rows. users ask what the tiers mean. Diego: Re: 1) We can add an aria-live region that announces: 'Filters collapsed. X filters selected.' when the rail toggles. Also add aria-expanded on the toggle button. Harpreet: Re: badges: propose a small legend accessible from the table header: a help icon that opens a lightweight modal with definitions and sample units (latency P95, throughput rps, and cost per 1k tokens). Harpreet: Legend copy idea: "Performance tiers: Latency-first (<50ms P95), Balanced (50-150ms P95), Throughput-first (>150ms P95). Measured on reference harness." Diego: For compact rows we could also surface an inline textual shorthand: e.g., "Latency" or "Cost" next to the icon, but in 11px that might be tight. Maybe show text on hover/focus. Nora: Hover-only text is ok but add keyboard focus reveal. Tooltip exposure is the alternative but make sure it is accessible and operable. Harpreet: Implementation sketch for the toggle: ```
{announceText}
``` Diego: Good. Also, when switching between density modes keep pinned rows visible and keep filter state — switching modes should not clear session state. Nora: Agreed. Found one more tiny visual nit: the badge border is 1px of brand color; at 12px it blends with the row border. Suggest increasing contrast or using a subtle shadow instead of same-color border. Harpreet: Will update Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/compact-compare-ux (WIP). I'll try two variants: legend modal vs inline expand on focus. Nora: Can we add an analytics event when users click the legend/help icon? want to see whether people use it. Diego: Yes: `catalog.legend.open` with payload { view: 'compare', density: 'compact' } (dev note: schema as strings). Nora: Next steps: Harpreet to prototype legend and updated badge styles; Diego to add aria-live announce + persist state across density toggle; I'll draft the microcopy for the legend and brief QA checklist for contrast + keyboard reveal. a11y-bot: Quick checks to include in PR: 1) Ensure aria-live announces filter state on toggle. 2) All badges must have aria-label and keyboard-accessible focus. 3) Legend/modal must be reachable and closeable via keyboard, and trap focus while open. 4) Contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for badge text and icons. Nora: Plan to ship as incremental improvement (no backend changes). We'll coordinate a small rollout and monitor analytics for legend usage. Diego: I'll open a small PR for the aria-live + state persist today. Harpreet: I'll drop the Figma link and mock images in the thread when ready. Nora: Thanks all — tagging product docs to add a short blurb explaining badge meanings if we land the legend.
